thread:
incidents-bot: PAGERS: elevated 5xx spike detected on inference-gateway-us-east-1 (alert rule: gateway_5xx_rate > 3% over 2m). Auto-pager sent to #incidents and oncall.
oncall-sre: Picking this up. Seeing a sudden jump in 502/504 and a cluster of upstream timeouts. Tags: gateway, envoy, lb-config. Paging devon and marta. @devon @marta can you ack? :rotating_light:
devon: acked. I'm checking envoy metrics and recent infra deploys. I see a config rollout ~18m ago touching route weights and retry policy.
marta: also acked. Looking at traces — lots of retries from gateway -> backend pool B, causing saturation and CBs tripping on pool B. Hypothesis: retries enabled upstream + aggressive retry policy caused retry amplification.
oncall-sre: Good summary. Can we confirm which config change did rollout 18m ago? @kai can you pull deploy history? Also spinning up a mitigation plan: 1) disable retries at gateway 2) increase circuit-breaker thresholds for pool B 3) shift some traffic to pool A 4) monitor error rate.
kai: rolling list now. Deploy 1765432 (ops/lb-route-weight-update) at 6765430965 by jamie. Diff shows changes to route /inference/*: added retry: attempts: 2, per_try_timeout: 2s and lowered cb max_pending_requests for pool B.
jamie: that was intended to reduce tail latency but we didn't account for backend B's lower capacity. Reverting weight changes if that helps.
devon: start with disabling retries. Envoy config has retries in the VirtualHost. I'll push a hotpatch to set `retry_policy: none` on the gateway route. Command:
```
# using configctl
configctl patch route inference --set "route.retry_policy=none" --env us-east-1
```
marta: also increasing cb limits on pool B to avoid cascade. Patch suggestion:
```
cluster:
  name: backend-pool-b
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      - max_connections: 5000
        max_pending_requests: 3000
```
len: any chance this is a client-side retry loop? I see backend logs showing `upstream_502` and many repeated requests with same trace id.
devon: saw those traces. They contain `x-retry-count` headers increasing. So gateway retries + service-level retries maybe. For quick mitigation I want to stop gateway retries first (fastest change) and then nudge consumers.
support-lead: customer impact check — current 5xx rate peaked at 6.4% across us-east, affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Estimated requests failing ~12k/min at peak. Notifying CS for pages to top customers. Opening incident ticket INC-2026.
oncall-sre: Ops-bot, initiate rollback of ops/lb-route-weight-update and apply temporary retry disable.
ops-bot: Initiating rollback: deploy 1765432 -> previous (1765420). Rollback job started at 6765432260. Rolling to 3 hosts at a time. CI checks running.
kai: rollback accepted by CI, starting rollout. Watching health checks.
jamie: I've also pushed a lean hotfix to gateway to set retry_policy none; rolling in us-east.
devon: verify with curl to gateway edge for a few requests:
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -D - https://gateway.us-east.example.com/v1/generate | head -n1; done
```
marta: logs show 200 responses returning for 8/10 after hotpatch, error rate dropping. Metrics: error_rate now 1.1% and falling.
oncall-sre: great. Keep monitoring for 10 minutes and then we'll decide if further action needed. Assign follow-ups: rollback journal, postmortem owner, alert tuning.
support-lead: CS notified customers A/B/C, any immediate compensation requests? None yet. Will escalate if more reports.
len: note for postmortem: check combined effect of route-weight shift + retry enable + backend capacity. Also add integration test for retry policy vs backend health.
jamie: root cause likely bad combo of lowering pool B CB + enabling retries. I'll own the postmortem and remediation CLs.
ops-bot: Rollback complete at 6765432380. All hosts report healthy. Canary checks passing.
oncall-sre: Confirmed stabilized. Error rate down to 0.6% and trending toward baseline. Declaring incident contained. Will keep thread open for a bit for follow-up tasks.
devon: adding a quick runbook note: if we see retry amplification again, immediate steps: 1) disable retries at gateway 2) add 20% traffic shift away from affected pool 3) raise cb thresholds 4) contact backend owner.
marta: adding dashboard alert adjustments: increase evaluation window to avoid flapping and add retry-amplification rule that correlates spike in retries header with 5xx.
support-lead: documenting customer impact summary in INC-2026 ticket.
oncall-sre: Thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: jamie. Action items: rollback verification, add integration test, alert tuning, runbook update. Closing on-call handoff in 15m. :white_check_mark:
